title: A complete temporal transcription factor code for motor neuron development

materials_reviewed.notes: Full text parsed from PDF and review_md. Temporal transcription factor codes and lineage trees reviewed.
Embryonic dissection, scRNA-seq pipeline, and developmental trajectory analysis methods reviewed.
Extended Data Fig. 4 (notochord, NMPs), Fig. 5 (podocytes, ureteric bud), Fig. 6-7 (renal stroma), Fig. 9 (optic stalk, RPCs), Fig. 10 (subplate neurons, VA astrocytes) thoroughly reviewed.

cluster_inventory: Notochord, NMPs, posterior intermediate mesoderm, podocytes, ureteric bud, renal cortical/medullary stroma, retinal progenitor cells, subplate neurons, cortical upper-layer neurons, VA-astrocytes, etc.
